transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 526 Lochshin Drive?
Yes, this is 526 Lochshin Drive. Just me and my partner here, no water inside, and we’re both fine.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are two people here, and neither of them can’t come to the phone.

Thank you for sharing that information with us. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just want to clarify — there’s no wheelchair or anyone bedbound.
Got it, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside the home right now. Just two people here, and neither needs to be left alone.
Thank you for sharing that update with us. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, I don’t have a high-clearance truck, boat, or any free seats in a vehicle to help neighbors. (I meant to say “I don’t have any of those to offer.”)
Thank you for sharing your situation clearly. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — two people, no water inside yet. Just to clarify, we’re both here and safe.
Thanks for confirming you’re both here and safe. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
